(DO ((A 1 (1+ A)) B) (IF-DONE B) ...)  in MACLISP to be equivalent to
(DO ((A 1 (1+ A)) (B)) (IF-DONE B) ...)   ??
I believe I extended the LET macro to permit singleton symbols.
